**arXiv:math/0008027v1 [math.GT] 3 Aug 2000**

*HYPERBOLIC KNOT AFTER Y. YOKOTA*

21 pp, 7 sections.

**Abstract.** I follow Y. Yokota to explain how to obtain a tetrahedron de- composition of the complement of a hyperbolic knot and compare it with the asymptotic behavior of Kashaev’s link invariant using the ﬁgure-eight knot as an example.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 Algebra; 3 Geometry; 3.1 Ideal tetrahedron decomposition of $S^3\se; 3.3 Hyperbolicity condition; 4 Analysis, and Harmony
